title: Fast Food Restaurant Franchise Opportunity
name: K-Bites Korean Street Food, 5 Franchisees, Est'd in 2025, Mumbai HQ
description: K-Bites | A Modern Korean QSR by Ambros World Foods. K-Bites is a modern Korean QSR concept by Ambros World Foods (AWF), bringing the growing popularity of Korean street food to India through a menu that combines authentic Korean-inspired flavours with adaptations suited to the Indian palate. The brand brings together some of Korea’s most popular street-food favourites, including Korean Fried Chicken, Tteokbokki, Korean Corn Dogs, Ramyeon, Kimbap and Bibimbap, presented in an approachable, contemporary format designed for today’s young and experience-driven consumers. Built as a scalable, asset-efficient QSR model, K-Bites is designed to operate across high streets, malls, food courts, kiosks and delivery-led locations, allowing franchise partners flexibility in selecting the right format for their market. Backed by AWF’s experience in F&B operations, brand development, marketing and franchise execution, K-Bites offers franchise partners an end-to-end support ecosystem covering site evaluation, setup, recruitment, training, SOPs, supply chain, marketing and ongoing operational support. With a focused menu, standardised recipes, strong product appeal and a cuisine that continues to gain traction among Indian consumers, K-Bites is positioned as a contemporary Korean QSR brand built for repeatability, scalability and multi-location growth.
